description: This file defines the CustomerMenuConfigurator class responsible for configuring menu items within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses traits for module screen helper functions. The class overrides the screen to 'viewCustomers' when its configure method is invoked.

classes.name: CustomerMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring customer menu items in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, overriding the screen to display customer-related views.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'viewCustomers' within the given Screen object.
